fullPassage:
Various Volunteer Activities You Might Want to Participate in

Reading Volunteer Work
It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. Additionally, you can participate in the production of audiobooks for them. This activity offers the advantage of relatively flexible scheduling. However, participants must meet certain standards, including completing their education and demonstrating proficiency in standard language use and pronunciation.

Tree Caring Volunteer Work
Adopt-a-tree is a volunteer activity that helps keep trees beautiful and clean. Planting trees is important, but it is also important to take good care of the trees once planted. It is a volunteer activity in which local organizations and residents adopt "my tree" and take care of it and keep it clean. The Seoul Green Trust, a non-profit foundation dedicated to expanding and preserving green spaces, organizes an annual event on Arbor Day. During this event, citizens come together to plant and care for trees along the Hangang River.

Longevity Photography Volunteer Work
Longevity photography is a service aimed at creating healthy and happy memories through pictures for the elderly. It is driven not only by a desire to help the elderly live longer but also to ease their financial burdens. In addition to photography services, you can also contribute through talent donations that match your skills, such as providing makeup or hairstyling for the photo shoots.

questions.passage: It is a volunteer activity that involves ①<u>reading</u> aloud to the visually ②<u>impaired</u> or young children. Additionally, you can participate in the production of audiobooks for ③<u>it</u>. This activity offers the advantage of relatively flexible ④<u>scheduling</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ it → them. 시각장애인과 어린 아이들(복수)을 가리키므로 them이 적절.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ③: 앞의 the visually impaired or young children(복수)을 받으므로 them이 맞음.
❌ ① reading: involves + ~ing (동명사) 적합
❌ ② impaired: the visually impaired (시각장애인) 적합
❌ ④ scheduling: flexible scheduling (유연한 일정) 적합
det.tip: 대명사 수 일치: 복수 선행사 → them, 단수 선행사 → it. the + 형용사 = ~한 사람들(복수)

questions.passage: Adopt-a-tree is a volunteer activity that helps ①<u>keeping</u> trees beautiful and clean. Planting trees is important, but it is also important to take good care of the trees once ②<u>planted</u>. It is a volunteer activity ③<u>in which</u> local organizations and residents adopt "my tree" and take care of ④<u>it</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① keeping → keep. help + 동사원형/to부정사. help keeping은 불가.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ①: help + 동사원형(keep) 또는 help + to부정사(to keep). help + ~ing는 비문.
❌ ② planted: once planted = once (they are) planted. 분사구문 적합.
❌ ③ in which: 전치사+관계대명사 적합.
❌ ④ it: "my tree"(단수)를 받음 적합.
det.tip: help + 동사원형/to부정사. help keep = help to keep. help ~ing는 불가.

questions.passage: Longevity photography is a service ①<u>aimed</u> at creating healthy and happy memories through pictures for the elderly. It is ②<u>driven</u> not only by a desire to help the elderly live longer but also to ease their financial burdens. In addition to photography services, you can also contribute through talent donations that ③<u>match</u> your skills, such as ④<u>provide</u> makeup or hairstyling for the photo shoots.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ provide → providing. such as + 동명사(~ing). such as 뒤에 동사원형은 불가.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ④: such as + 동명사. such as providing이 적합.
❌ ① aimed: 과거분사가 service를 수식. aimed at ~ing 적합.
❌ ② driven: It is driven by = 수동태 적합.
❌ ③ match: donations that match (관계대명사+동사) 적합.
det.tip: such as + 명사/동명사. such as providing = 제공하는 것과 같은

questions.passage: However, participants must meet certain standards, including ①<u>completing</u> their education and ②<u>demonstrate</u> proficiency in standard language use and pronunciation. The Seoul Green Trust, a non-profit foundation ③<u>dedicated</u> to expanding and preserving green spaces, ④<u>organizes</u> an annual event on Arbor Day.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② demonstrate → demonstrating. including 뒤 병렬 구조: completing A and demonstrating B.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ②: including + 동명사 병렬 구조. completing and demonstrating이 적합.
❌ ① completing: including + ~ing 적합.
❌ ③ dedicated: 과거분사가 foundation을 수식. dedicated to ~ing 적합.
❌ ④ organizes: The Seoul Green Trust(단수주어) + organizes(단수동사) 적합.
det.tip: 병렬 구조: A and B 동일 형태. including completing ... and demonstrating ...

questions.passage: It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. Additionally, you can participate in the production of audiobooks for them. This activity offers the advantage of relatively __________ scheduling. However, participants must meet certain standards, including completing their education.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 비교적 유연한(flexible) 일정의 이점.
det.analysis:
✅ ① flexible: relatively flexible scheduling. 원문 표현.
❌ ② annual(연례)은 행사 빈도 관련
❌ ③ impaired(손상된)는 시각 관련
❌ ④ non-profit(비영리)는 재단 관련
det.tip: flexible scheduling = 유연한 일정. relatively flexible = 비교적 유연한

questions.passage: Longevity photography is a service aimed at creating healthy and happy memories through pictures for the elderly. It is driven not only by a desire to help the elderly live longer but also to ease their financial __________. In addition to photography services, you can also contribute through talent donations.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 재정적 부담(burdens)을 완화하기 위해.
det.analysis:
✅ ② burdens: ease their financial burdens. 원문 표현.
❌ ① memories(추억)는 서비스 목적
❌ ③ donations(기부)는 재능 기부
❌ ④ skills(기술)은 매칭 관련
det.tip: ease one's financial burdens = 재정적 부담을 덜다

questions.passage: It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. Additionally, you can participate in the production of audiobooks for them.
questions.stem: 낭독 봉사활동에서는 시각장애인이나 어린이를 위한 오디오북 제작에 참여할 수 있다.

det.korean: T: 원문에 '시각장애인이나 어린이를 위한 오디오북 제작에 참여할 수 있다'고 명시.
det.analysis:
✅ T: "you can participate in the production of audiobooks for them" 원문 일치.
them = the visually impaired or young children
det.tip: additionally(게다가)로 추가 정보 제시. audiobooks = 오디오북

questions.passage: The Seoul Green Trust, a non-profit foundation dedicated to expanding and preserving green spaces, organizes an annual event on Arbor Day. During this event, citizens come together to plant and care for trees along the Hangang River.
questions.stem: 서울그린트러스트는 매년 크리스마스에 한강을 따라 나무를 심는 행사를 연다.

det.korean: F: 원문은 식목일(Arbor Day)에 행사를 연다고 했지, 크리스마스가 아니다.
det.analysis:
✅ F: on Arbor Day(식목일) ≠ 크리스마스. 시기를 변조한 오답.
나머지(한강, 나무 심기)는 원문과 일치.
det.tip: 세부 사항(날짜/시기) 변조에 주의. Arbor Day = 식목일

questions.passage: Longevity photography is a service aimed at creating healthy and happy memories through pictures for the elderly. It is driven not only by a desire to help the elderly live longer but also to ease their financial burdens.
questions.stem: 장수사진 봉사활동은 노인들의 재정적 부담을 늘리기 위한 것이기도 하다.

det.korean: F: 원문은 재정적 부담을 덜어주기(ease) 위한 것이지, 늘리기 위한 것이 아니다.
det.analysis:
✅ F: ease(완화) ≠ 늘리기(increase). 의미를 반대로 변조.
원문: "to ease their financial burdens"
det.tip: ease(완화하다, 줄이다) ↔ increase(늘리다). 동사의 의미 변조에 주의.

ch: the financial cost of audiobook production
the advantage of relatively flexible scheduling
the need for strict educational backgrounds
questions.passage: It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. Additionally, you can participate in the production of audiobooks for them. This activity offers __________. However, participants must meet certain standards, including completing their education and demonstrating proficiency in standard language use and pronunciation.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 활동은 비교적 유연한 일정의 이점(the advantage of relatively flexible scheduling)을 제공한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ the advantage of relatively flexible scheduling: 원문 그대로.
❌ ① visual impairment는 대상이지 이점 아님
❌ ② financial cost는 언급되지 않음
❌ ④ strict educational backgrounds는 기준이지 이점 아님
det.tip: This activity offers... However... 구조: 이점 제시 후 단서(조건) 제시

ch: not only by a desire to help the elderly live longer but also to ease their financial burdens
mainly by the need to reduce medical costs for the elderly
by the government's policy to promote photography services
only by the wish to create memories for elderly people
questions.passage: Adopt-a-tree is a volunteer activity that helps keep trees beautiful and clean. The Seoul Green Trust, a non-profit foundation dedicated to expanding and preserving green spaces, organizes an annual event on Arbor Day. Longevity photography is a service aimed at creating healthy and happy memories through pictures for the elderly. It is driven __________. In addition to photography services, you can also contribute through talent donations that match your skills, such as providing makeup or hairstyling for the photo shoots.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 노인들이 더 오래 살도록 돕고자 하는 바람뿐 아니라 재정적 부담을 덜어주기(ease their financial burdens) 위해서.
det.analysis:
✅ ① not only ... but also 구조로 두 가지 동기 제시. 원문 일치.
❌ ② medical costs는 언급 없음
❌ ③ government's policy는 언급 없음
❌ ④ only는 부적합 (not only...but also 구조)
det.tip: not only A but also B: A뿐만 아니라 B도. 두 가지 동기를 모두 포함해야 정답.

ch: 낭독 봉사활동은 일정을 자유롭게 조절할 수 있는 장점이 있다.
나무돌봄 봉사활동에서 서울그린트러스트는 식목일에 행사를 조직한다.
장수사진 봉사활동은 젊은 세대를 위한 사진 서비스이다.
낭독 봉사에는 특별한 자격 기준이 필요하지 않다.
questions.passage:
It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. This activity offers the advantage of relatively flexible scheduling. However, participants must meet certain standards, including completing their education and demonstrating proficiency in standard language use and pronunciation.

Longevity photography is a service aimed at creating healthy and happy memories through pictures for the elderly.
questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ② 서울그린트러스트는 식목일(Arbor Day)에 행사를 조직한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 원문: "organizes an annual event on Arbor Day" 일치.
❌ ① '자유롭게'는 과장. 원문은 'relatively flexible'
❌ ③ 젊은 세대가 아니라 노인(the elderly)
❌ ④ 원문: "must meet certain standards" — 기준 필요함
det.tip: relatively(비교적) ≠ 완전히 자유롭게. 세부 표현 차이에 주의.

ch: 나무돌봄 봉사는 나무를 아름답고 깨끗하게 유지하는 것을 돕는다.
서울그린트러스트는 녹지 확장과 보존에 전념하는 비영리 재단이다.
장수사진 봉사는 노인들의 재정적 부담을 늘리기 위한 것이기도 하다.
재능 기부로 메이크업이나 헤어스타일링을 제공할 수 있다.
questions.passage:
Adopt-a-tree is a volunteer activity that helps keep trees beautiful and clean. The Seoul Green Trust, a non-profit foundation dedicated to expanding and preserving green spaces, organizes an annual event on Arbor Day.
Longevity photography is a service aimed at creating healthy and happy memories through pictures for the elderly. It is driven not only by a desire to help the elderly live longer but also to ease their financial burdens. In addition to photography services, you can also contribute through talent donations that match your skills, such as providing makeup or hairstyling for the photo shoots.
questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ③ 재정적 부담을 늘리기 → 원문: ease(완화). 반대로 변조.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ③: ease(완화) ≠ 늘리기. 의미 반대로 변조.
❌ ① 원문 일치: helps keep trees beautiful and clean
❌ ② 원문 일치: dedicated to expanding and preserving
❌ ④ 원문 일치: providing makeup or hairstyling
det.tip: ease(완화하다)의 의미를 정확히 파악. ease ≠ increase/worsen

questions.passage: ①Adopt-a-tree is a volunteer activity that helps keep trees beautiful and clean. ②Planting trees is important, but it is also important to take good care of the trees once planting. ③It is a volunteer activity in which local organizations and residents adopt "my tree" and take care of it. ④The Seoul Green Trust organizes an annual event on Arbor Day.
questions.stem: 위 문장들 중 어법상 오류가 있는 것은?

det.korean: ② planting → planted. once planted = once (they are) planted. 분사구문에서 수동 의미.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ②: once planted(심어진 후) — 나무가 심어지는 것이므로 과거분사. once planting은 부적합.
❌ ① helps keep: help + 동사원형 적합
❌ ③ in which: 전치사+관계대명사 적합
❌ ④ organizes: 단수주어+단수동사 적합
det.tip: once + 과거분사: once planted = 일단 심어지면. 수동 의미일 때 과거분사 사용.

questions.passage: It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. Additionally, you can participate in the production of audiobooks for them. This activity offers the advantage of relatively flexible scheduling.
questions.stem: 위 글에서, 시각장애인이나 어린이를 위해 참여할 수 있는 제작물의 이름을 본문에서 찾아 **영어**로 쓰시오.

det.korean: 오디오북(audiobooks) 제작에 참여할 수 있다.
det.analysis: the production of audiobooks for them — 시각장애인과 어린이를 위한 오디오북.
det.tip: audiobook = 오디오북. production of audiobooks = 오디오북 제작

questions.passage: The Seoul Green Trust, a non-profit foundation dedicated to expanding and preserving green spaces, organizes an annual event on Arbor Day. During this event, citizens come together to plant and care for trees along the Hangang River.
questions.stem: 위 글에서, 서울그린트러스트가 녹지 확장과 함께 전념하는 또 다른 활동을 본문에서 찾아 **영어** 단어로 쓰시오.

det.korean: 녹지를 보존(preserving)하는 데 전념.
det.analysis: dedicated to expanding and preserving — expanding(확장)과 함께 preserving(보존)이 또 다른 활동.
det.tip: preserving(보존). dedicated to expanding and preserving green spaces

questions.stem: 다음 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오: dedicated / spaces / green / a / to / preserving / non-profit / expanding / foundation / and

det.korean: 녹지 확장과 보존에 전념하는 비영리 재단.
det.analysis: a non-profit foundation dedicated to expanding and preserving green spaces — 동격 삽입구.
det.tip: a non-profit foundation + dedicated to ~ing. 과거분사구가 명사를 후치수식.

questions.passage:
It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. Additionally, you can participate in the production of audiobooks for them.

questions.stem: 윗글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ 다양한 종류의 봉사활동 소개: 낭독, 나무돌봄, 장수사진 세 가지.
det.analysis:

❌ ① 나무 심기만이 아님
❌ ② 교육 프로그램이 아님
❌ ④ 문제점이 아니라 소개
det.tip: 제목: Various Volunteer Activities. 다양한 봉사활동의 종류와 특징 소개.

ch: 사람들이 자신의 재능과 시간을 활용하여 지역사회에 기여하는 다양한 봉사 활동

❌ ④ 노인 복지만이 아님

다음 조건에 맞게 영작하시오.
조건: '노인들을 위해 사진을 통해 건강하고 행복한 추억을 만드는 것을 목표로 하는'

det.korean: 노인들을 위해 사진을 통해 건강하고 행복한 추억을 만드는 것을 목표로 하는(aimed at creating).
det.analysis: aimed at ~ing = ~을 목표로 하는. through pictures = 사진을 통해. for the elderly = 노인을 위해.
det.tip: aimed at creating = 만드는 것을 목표로 하는. be aimed at ~ing 구문 활용.
